about: The epistola of the formulary “12th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: We have such confidence toward God through Christ: not that we are sufficient to think anything by ourselves, as if it came from ourselves, but our sufficiency is from God, who has also made us qualified ministers of a new covenant, not by the letter but by the spirit; for the letter kills, while the spirit gives life. Now if the ministration of death, formed in letters upon stones, was in glory, so that the sons of Israel could not fix their eyes on the face of Moses because of the glory of his countenance, which is passing away, how will the ministration of the Spirit not be in glory all the more? For if the ministration of condemnation is glory, the ministry of justice abounds much more in glory.
